channel.title: Comic99 News
channel.description: Auto-curated comic, manga and anime news by Comic99

item.title: 'Youchien Wars' Unveils Additional Staff, Main Promo, Opening Theme
item.description: The official website for the anime adaptation of You Chiba's action comedy manga revealed additional staff and opening theme details. The series launches on TV Tokyo network stations in April 2027.

item.title: 'Himekishi-sama no Himo' Reveals Supporting Cast, Second Promo
item.description: The television adaptation of Tooru Shirogane's action fantasy light novel announced its supporting cast and released a second promotional video ahead of its January premiere.

item.title: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast, Ending Song, January 3 Debut
item.description: A new promotional video for The Kept Man of the Princess Knight anime has unveiled additional voice actors Yūya Hirose, Manaka Iwami, Shion Wakayama, and Saori Ōnishi, along with the ending theme song ahead of its January 3 premiere.

item.title: Rising travel costs push KME 2026 buyers toward South Korea’s secondary cities - TTGmice
item.description: KME 2026 attendees are increasingly considering secondary cities in South Korea as travel expenses continue to rise, according to industry reports.

item.title: Supporting Cast for 'Cheat Fuyo' Announced
item.description: The supporting cast for the anime adaptation of "The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Sage" has been revealed through the official announcement channel.

item.title: Marvel Reveals Spider-Man's Official Debut as the Avengers' New Leader
item.description: Marvel's upcoming Amazing Spider-Man issue features the web-slinger assuming leadership of the Avengers for the first time in an official capacity.

item.title: 7 Mid Manga That Are Only Popular Because of Anime Adaptations
item.description: Several manga series owe their popularity primarily to their anime adaptations rather than the source material itself, according to a report examining the phenomenon.

item.title: 'Historie' Unveils Production Staff, Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
item.description: The television adaptation of Hitoshi Iwaaki's Historie manga has announced its production team, additional cast members, and opening and closing theme songs ahead of its January 9 premiere as a two-episode special.

item.title: 15 Ways Calvin and Hobbes Has Aged Poorly
item.description: Comic Book Resources examines aspects of the classic comic strip that have not aged well, suggesting that despite its iconic status, certain elements no longer resonate with modern audiences.

item.title: Peacock's New Epic Science Fantasy Series Is Coming to Dethrone Star Wars for Good
item.description: Peacock is developing a streaming adaptation of Dungeon Crawler Carl, blending high fantasy and science fiction elements for its platform.

item.title: Historie Anime's Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, Theme Songs, January 8 Debut
item.description: The Historie anime will premiere January 8 with additional cast and staff revealed alongside theme song announcements. The expanding cast includes Fumihiko Tachiki, Akira Sekine, Toshiki Masuda, Ryōta Takeuchi, and Seiichirō Yamashita.

item.title: 'Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete Kosodate~' Anime's Teaser Reveals More Cast, Ending Song
item.description: A new anime adaptation revealed additional cast members and ending theme details. Jin Urayama, Hitomi Shogawa, Nao Shiraki, and Akiko Seri join the project, with Kuricorder Quartet providing music.

item.title: Live-Action 10 Things I Want to Do Before I Turn 40 Film's Trailer Reveals Theme Song
item.description: A live-action adaptation based on a manga series will release January 22, with singer sumika contributing the opening track "Taisetsu."

item.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Manga Gets Spinoff Manga Mini-Series
item.description: A new spinoff manga series based on Frieren: Beyond Journey's End will debut on December 2.

item.title: Live-Action 2027 Kaiji Film Unveils Full Trailer, Poster, More Cast
item.description: A live-action adaptation of Kaiji scheduled for January 29, 2027, has released promotional materials and announced additional cast members including Katsuhisa Namase and Ken Mitsuishi.

item.title: Devils' Crest ‒ Episode 4
item.description: The fourth episode of Devils' Crest draws comparisons to survival fiction, suggesting a shift toward darker storytelling elements in the series.

item.title: Dragon Ball Brings Back Goku and Bulma's Original Pre-Series Designs for 42nd Anniversary
item.description: Dragon Ball celebrated its 42nd anniversary by revealing early character designs for Goku and Bulma before the manga's debut, offering fans a look at the franchise's original artwork.

item.title: One Piece Manga Reading Order: Every Saga, Volume And Box Set Before Volume 116 - AnimeMojo.com
item.description: A comprehensive guide details the reading sequence for One Piece through volume 115, organizing the series by saga and available box set collections for manga fans.

item.title: 6 Iconic Mangas That Crossed 1200 Chapters Before One Piece, Ranked - FandomWire
item.description: A ranking article examines six long-running manga series that surpassed 1200 chapters before One Piece achieved that milestone.

item.title: Crunchyroll Brings Manga Reading Zones, Exclusive Merchandise, and CrunchyCoins to Comic Cons Across India - OtakuKart
item.description: Crunchyroll is expanding its presence at Indian comic conventions with dedicated manga reading areas, special merchandise offerings, and an in-convention currency system for attendees.
